caption: The drawing depicts a small, box-shaped puppet theater with lattice-designed sides, colored predominantly in red, yellow, and blue. The front of the theater features the words "PUNCH & JUDY BANK" in yellow within a triangular pediment bordered in red. Underneath, there is a stage area framed by blue curtains with gray tiebacks, showing two puppets: one on the left with a pink hat and blue clothing, and the other on the right with a yellow hat, red collar, red-and-white outfit, and holding a stick. The lower part of the theater is decorated with a yellow patterned panel and a central geometric, star-like design in red and blue. The overall background of the drawing is a plain beige color.
title: Punch and Judy Penny Bank
